title: Review of c04's crawler size threshold: reproduced exactly on seeds 3 and 4 (the probe is seed-independent) and it holds at dt/2: R=8 stops by t~60, R=12 crawls at 0.76, sigma=1.3/alpha=4 keeps R=8 at 0.95
summary: Looked at probe/speeds.txt and static_daughters/sheet.png, then re-ran the author's speed probe with a seed argument (speed_seed.py) on seeds 3 and 4 and at dt/2 (speed_dt.py, dt 0.025, same time sampling), and ran labkit on the positive-control world with R0=8 on seed 3 (rerun/seed3). Seeds 3 and 4 give exactly the author's seed-0 numbers (one planted cell at a fixed place: the seed changes nothing), so the fresh seeds test nothing; the dt/2 run is the real check: R=8 decays 0.77 -> 0.49 -> 0.19 -> 0 by t~60 (author 0.78 -> 0 by t~80), R=10 crawls 0.86-0.60 then stops by t~120 (author ~160), R=12 settles at 0.76 (author's dt 0.79). With sigma=1.3, alpha=4 an R=8 cell crawls at a steady 0.95 on seeds 3 and 4. labkit on R=8: one track, max 2.2 body lengths before it stops (rerun/seed3/FACTS.md).

observations.M: speeds_dt2.txt (dt/2): R=8 0 by t~60, R=10 0 by t~120, R=12 steady 0.76; speeds_review.txt: R=8 sigma 1.3 alpha 4 steady 0.95; rerun/seed3/FACTS.md max 2.2 BL for R=8

controls_run.M: speeds_dt2.txt: the same target-radius series at dt/2

verdicts.limitation: The probe is deterministic and seed-independent, so seeds do not test robustness; at dt/2 the R=10 cell stops ~40 t earlier, so the exact threshold radius (10-12 at alpha 3, sigma 0.6) moves slightly with the step.
